subject: PO ghost lines & spend cap mismatch - FastScale onboarding
content:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Joanna Lee <joanna.lee@fastscale.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: PO ghost lines & spend cap mismatch - FastScale onboarding

Hi Joanna —

Quick heads-up while we finish the onboarding checklist: our procurement ledger shows an unexpected increase in encumbrance tied to the FastScale onboarding POs. It looks like a pair of duplicate/phantom line items were created in your portal during the initial CSV upload, and they pushed the total above the agreed spend cap.

What I need from you:
- Confirm whether the extra line items on PO #00012345 are legitimate or duplicates from the upload.
- If duplicates, please retract those lines and reissue a corrected PO PDF so we can clear the encumbrance.
- If you need a split (two POs) to keep us under the $120,000 monthly cap, let us know the best PO numbers to use.

Attached: a stub of the PO we see in our system (PO_00012345_stub.pdf) and your onboarding form we received.

Thanks — we want to avoid an invoice hold and get the onboarding spend correctly reserved.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

Attachments: PO_00012345_stub.pdf (pdf stub), fastscale_onboarding_form_v2.xlsx (excel form)

----- Original message follows -----

From: Joanna Lee <joanna.lee@fastscale.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:02:13 -0400
Subject: Re: PO ghost lines & spend cap mismatch - FastScale onboarding

Hi Sean —

Thanks for flagging this. I checked with our onboarding team — during the CSV import two identical service rows were created for one of the SKU bundles (internal id SKU-FS-BUNDLE-1). That would explain the $8,400 delta you see.

Planned next steps from our side:
- We will retract the duplicate lines from PO #00012345 and push an updated PO to you by end of day.
- If Redwood prefers, we can instead split the amounts into PO #00012345 and PO #00012346; we can populate the split so the monthly cap is respected.

Can you confirm which approach you prefer? If you send me the exact encumbrance numbers you want released/retained per PO, I will match them on our end and send the revised PDF.

Apologies for the noise — the CSV importer behavior was missed in our QA.

Best,
Joanna
Joanna Lee
Vendor Onboarding Lead | FastScale
joanna.lee@fastscale.com
procure@fastscale.com

-----

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Joanna Lee <joanna.lee@fastscale.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: PO ghost lines & spend cap mismatch - FastScale onboarding

Kimberly / Marissa — forwarding the vendor reply. Summary: duplicate CSV rows caused two extra line items on PO_00012345 and that created an $8,400 overshoot of the monthly spend cap. Joanna is offering to either retract the duplicate lines or split the amount across a second PO.

Numbers from our ledger (encumbrance snapshot 2027-04-16 08:00 PDT):
- Configured monthly spend cap (FastScale): $120,000
- Current encumbered amount before vendor fix: $128,400
- Delta: $8,400 (appears to be two duplicate lines at $4,200 each)

Options I see:
1) Ask vendor to retract duplicates and reissue the corrected PO (single PO). Quickest for clearing the excess encumbrance.
2) Accept a split: vendor issues PO_00012345 for $120,000 and PO_00012346 for $8,400 (or vice versa). Finance will need explicit PO numbers to map budgets.

Request: Kimberly, can Procurement either authorize option 1 (retraction + corrected PO) or approve option 2 (split) and assign the second PO number? Marissa, FYI on potential encumbrance reallocation and impact to month-end reporting.

Thanks,
Sean

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Joanna Lee <joanna.lee@fastscale.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: PO ghost lines & spend cap mismatch - FastScale onboarding

Thanks Sean — reviewed the encumbrance detail. Procurement confirms: FastScale has a $120k monthly spend cap (contract clause 2.1). The $128,400 encumbrance is above the cap and we cannot let that persist into month-end without additional approvals.

Procurement recommendation:
- Option A (preferred): Joanna retracts the two duplicate lines and reissues PO_00012345 corrected for $120,000. Vendor sends updated PDF and a short note confirming the removal of the duplicate CSV lines. This clears the encumbrance back to contracted level.
- Option B (acceptable): Vendor issues PO_00012346 for $8,400 and marks it as a separate, off-cycle PO tied to a one-time overage account. Finance (Marissa) must approve the off-cycle encumbrance and file for an exception.

If we go with Option B, Marissa please confirm whether an off-cycle allocation is approvable for this vendor and whether the payment team needs a separate approval flow.

Sooj, looping you for final authorization if there is any move to accept Option B or to issue credits.

Kimberly Park
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

-----Quoted message-----
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
> Summary and ledger snapshot attached.


From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO ghost lines & spend cap mismatch - FastScale onboarding

Thanks for the heads up. Finance can process an off-cycle allocation, but we prefer Option A so month-end reporting doesn't need an exception. If procurement prefers Option B, I will need:
- The vendor's off-cycle PO number (PO_00012346) and contact for invoicing
- A copy of the vendor confirmation note that the duplicate lines are intentional (if they claim a change) or the revised PO if they retract

If vendor retracts and reissues a corrected PO, I will clear the temporary encumbrance once the revised PO arrives and we reconcile the invoice.

-Marissa Cole
Staff Accountant, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

-----

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Joanna Lee <joanna.lee@fastscale.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO ghost lines & spend cap mismatch - FastScale onboarding

Approved: procurement should ask the vendor to retract the duplicate lines and reissue the corrected PO_00012345 reflecting $120,000. Finance will clear the temporary encumbrance after we receive the revised PDF and a short confirmation email from FastScale that the duplicates were from the CSV import and have been removed.

Action items:
- Joanna (FastScale): retract duplicate lines and send updated PO PDF and a one-line confirmation email.
- Kimberley: confirm when our ledger shows the corrected encumbrance so Joanna can close on her side.
- Marissa: hold off on off-cycle approvals unless vendor insists on a split.

Thanks all —
Soojin Lee
VP, Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
